records.issue_text: packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts:75 unconditionally refreshes directly through Salesforce instead of refreshOAuthTokens, preventing shared credentials from refreshing through the configured parent application and rejecting connection initialization even when the supplied access token remains valid.
records.rationale: The diff shows the new Salesforce code calls fetch to login.salesforce.com directly and never wraps it in refreshOAuthTokens like every other CalendarService/VideoApiAdapter in this PR (google, hubspot, lark, office365, webex, zoom, zoho), so with APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED + CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT set, Salesforce credentials will not sync/refresh through the parent application, and the refresh runs unconditionally at connection creation. This is a real inconsistency introduced by the diff.
